title: Engine Oil Filter Housing — Installation

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the oil filter housing with the shim and clearance settings that suit the casting standard fitted, followed by a ground run, a leak check and a hot clearance check at the heat shield.

sections.purpose: This task gives the installation of the oil filter housing, the setting of the mount shims, and the ground run and clearance checks that close the installation.
sections.job_setup_note: Identify the casting standard of the housing before you start, because the mount shim values and the heat shield relief differ between the original and the requalified standard. The requalified housing must never be installed against the original heat shield. Have the feeler gauge set and the shim pack available at the aircraft; the clearance cannot be set by eye.
sections.procedure: Confirm the casting standard of the housing to be fitted and select the shim table for it. CAUTION: DO NOT INSTALL THE REQUALIFIED HOUSING AGAINST THE ORIGINAL HEAT SHIELD. THE THERMAL GROWTH OF THE REPLACEMENT CASTING WILL CLOSE THE CLEARANCE AND THE HOUSING WILL CONTACT THE SHIELD IN THE CRUISE. Clean the mounting faces and inspect them. Offer the housing with two persons and engage the inboard mount link D7920124662661, shimming to the value in the table. Install the clamp kit D7920122286375 at the aft attachment, using the longer slot for the requalified standard. Fit plain washers EN229783-6C at every mount position and torque all fasteners to the values in the illustration. Connect the oil lines with new seals and torque the couplings. Install the heat shield PED599919-30 and the forward clamp ZED715928-89, and measure the cold clearance between the housing and the shield with the feeler gauge. Close the cowl latch CAD307983-03 and the fan cowl doors. Replenish the oil system to the full mark. WARNING: KEEP CLEAR OF THE INTAKE AND EXHAUST DANGER AREAS DURING THE GROUND RUN. Do a ground run to the idle condition and hold it for ten minutes. Shut down, open the cowls and do a leak check.
sections.close_out: Measure the hot clearance at the heat shield within five minutes of shutdown and record it with the cold clearance and the shim values used. Record the casting standard fitted at the position, because a mixed fleet standard has to be tracked. Confirm the oil level after the run and close the cowl doors. Close the technical log entry made at removal.

type_data.effectivity_note: Auran installations on TTN-88W1 and TTN-88W2 aircraft. Use the second shim table for the requalified casting standard.

safety_precautions: Do not install the requalified housing against the original heat shield.
Keep clear of the intake and exhaust danger areas during the ground run.
Support the fan cowl doors on their stays while working.

tooling.description: Feeler gauge set, heat shield clearance
